_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27), second read. The first read (45953358884, pp.63-67) shows the Cal-GETC pattern opens on PDF p.64 ('The California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)', 'Cal-GETC Requirements') and runs through p.65, before its FAQS on p.66; 45285's read held p.65 alone. Los Angeles Trade-Technical prints each award's Academic Plan code (T0 and the control number), so this read prints every page of the catalog that names 045285 or a Cal-GETC certificate: whether the certificate has a section of its own apart from the pattern's pages. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.certificate_section: Any page that prints Academic Plan T045285 or a Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement section, with its heading, lists and total.
